says: In next/, QuotaSettings.instance, which reads the quota limits from a Worker's INSTANCE text, is exported and called by nothing, product or test. The live objects get their limits from the checked start input through QuotaSettings.limits. Smallest fix: delete it.
proof: A search of next/ for QuotaSettings finds only cloudflare/quotas.ts:22, :36 and :49 (limits) and cloudflare/quotas.test.ts:102-112 (read); the name instance appears only at its own definition, cloudflare/QuotaSettings.ts:65.
cost: A second, unused way to read the limits stays in the package, and a reader may take it for the path the Worker runs.
